geom_reference_point: mount_plane = M origin at mount face (Z_M=0, reBot-interface bolt-array center); primitives placed by center_offset from it

mount_face_M.note: reBot URDF base (frame M) attaches here at top of flange boss; T_SM is read off CAD once plate is placed on the servicer front task face (frame S). Old symbol ^S T_B == T_SM per coordinate SSOT.

features.frame_M_axes: +Z_M = mount-face normal toward arm reach; +X_M along task-face / main bolt array; +Y_M completes RH
features.stackup_note: Adapter lies entirely on -Z_M side of mount face. Flange boss spans Z=-15..0 (mount face at top, Z=0). Plate spans Z=-27..-15. Plate bottom (Z=-27) = servicer front-task-bay interface.

bolt_pattern_M.note: Placeholder only, no final hardware claimed (ADP-01 / flange-bolt placeholder). PCD and count pending reBot base ICD.

features.servicer_bolt_pattern_note: Adapter-to-servicer fasteners near plate corners at approx (+-65, +-65, -27) mm on plate bottom; placeholder, no final hardware.

reBot_bolt_access.note: Reserve for reBot fasteners and tool access above mount face; no structure or cable routing inside.

folded_arm_envelope.note: Placeholder reBot stowed/folded-arm envelope on +Z_M side. Metadata only, NOT a built solid. Must be overlaid vs solar-panel deployment zone, camera FOV, antenna, servicer body and target/debris envelopes (ADP-03, keepout checklist). Final geometry pending reBot folded config.

cable_channel.note: Reserved cable passage bus bay -> robot base (power/data/sensor/E-stop), routed outside arm motion envelope and solar-panel deployment zone (ADP-03). Metadata only; block-model union cuts no hole.

ft_interface_plane_M.note: Stage 2 virtual force/torque interface at mount face (ADP-04); no physical F/T sensor volume claimed.

features.T_SM_status: TBD (Stage 1-C). Not fixed numerically here; to be exported and reviewed with this adapter model since it is the mechanical-to-dynamics bridge (small change alters coupled inertia / base reaction).
features.protrusion_rule_note: CDS Rev14.1 6.5 mm protrusion and 8.5 mm rail-to-first-protrusion checks are stowed-rail-envelope checks in frame S (P0), not resolved in this M-frame block model.

assumptions: Self-designed adapter: no open CAD reused (mapping v0 sec.5). reBot base frame M must match reBot-DevArm_fixend.urdf convention; SpaceRobotEnv v_base.stl is visual reference only.

Frame M per coordinate SSOT: origin at adapter mounting-plate datum / reBot-interface bolt-array center on the mount face; +Z_M mount-face normal toward arm reach; +X_M along task-face/main bolt array; +Y_M completes RH.
Mount face placed at Z_M=0 (top of flange boss) = where reBot URDF base bolts on. Adapter body entirely on -Z_M side (toward servicer).
T_SM (old ^S T_B) is NOT fixed numerically at Stage 1-C; the mount_face_M origin/normal lets it be read off CAD once the plate is located on the servicer (S) front task face.

Plate 160 x 160 x 12 mm assumed to fit within the 12U servicer front-task-face rail keepout (front face assumed >= 200 x 200 mm); rail/protrusion CDS checks deferred to S-frame stowed-envelope analysis.
Flange boss diameter 100 mm (r=50) x 15 mm is a placeholder reBot-base pilot/register; final diameter pending reBot base ICD.
reBot base bolt pattern placeholder: PCD 80 mm, 4 fasteners at 45/135/225/315 deg; no final hardware claimed (ADP-01).
Bolt-access keepout cylinder r=55 mm, Z=0..+20 mm reserved for reBot fasteners/tool clearance; no structure or cabling inside.

Folded-arm keepout envelope (cylinder r=120 mm x 350 mm on +Z_M) is placeholder metadata, NOT a built solid; must be overlaid against solar-panel deployment, camera FOV, antenna, body and target/debris envelopes (ADP-03).
Cable routing channel reserved off-axis in plate (~x=+55 mm) as metadata only; block-model union cuts no hole. Cables routed outside arm motion envelope and solar-panel deployment zone (ADP-03).
Force/torque interface modeled as a virtual plane at the mount face (Z_M=0) for Stage 2 (ADP-04); no purchased/physical F/T sensor claimed.

Target mass 1.2 kg is a stated-assumption estimate: Al-6061 (rho=2700 kg/m^3) over plate+boss volume ~4.25e-4 m^3 (~1.15 kg) plus rib/reinforcement allowance; builder sizes effective density to hit it. Inertia self-defined, low confidence, recorded separately (ADP-05, mapping 'inertia must be self-defined').
Block-model rule honored: only a box (plate) + a cylinder (flange boss), unioned; no fillets, holes, threads, ribs, or pockets modeled (reinforcement/lightening folded into effective density).
Adapter is a servicer-side mount (not target/debris): grasp_points, marker_points, and tumble_axis are not applicable and omitted.
All dimensions in millimeters; frame M is right-handed.
